question: Should session-memory use the shared transcript-only assistant predicate to suppress duplicate gateway-injected rows, accepting the resulting session-state projection change?
rationale: The patch is narrow and proof-backed, but it changes what persisted assistant bookkeeping rows are available to future memory recall, which is a maintainer-owned risk decision.

options.title: Land the shared-predicate filter
options.body: Accept that duplicate delivery-mirror and gateway-injected rows should be omitted from session-memory when their sanitized text repeats the previous visible assistant reply.

options.title: Require a stricter lineage guard
options.body: Ask for an additional parent or source-identity check before gateway-injected rows can be suppressed, reducing false-drop risk at the cost of more complexity.

options.title: Keep delivery-mirror-only filtering
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's narrower behavior, leaving duplicate gateway-injected rows in session-memory until a separate policy is chosen.

recommendation.title: Land the shared-predicate filter
recommendation.body: Accept that duplicate delivery-mirror and gateway-injected rows should be omitted from session-memory when their sanitized text repeats the previous visible assistant reply.
